---
title: Unicode display of Greek musical notation
---


In addition to Greek musical characters in their own Unicode block, we need combining characters from a separate block for the length marks (diseme, triseme, tetraseme and pentaseme), and for the raised dot indicating arsis.

*mousike* supplies an openly licensed font for this purpose. It should be applied only to the musical notation: to keep its size small, it includes upper case versions of signs where Unicode expects you to recycle alphabetic code points as musical notes, but includes no but no lower-case Greek or Latin.
